proposal.reason: Primary change is in transport behavior: P2P/SHM connection setup/cleanup, host/device stream synchronization, connect-progress accounting, IPC registration/address-table handling, and CE control shared-memory descriptor lifecycle. Additional device-topology review is needed because new NET-vs-P2P/SHM bandwidth checks (including NET_DISABLE_INTRA and ncclTopoCheckNet path logic) materially change intra-node path eligibility.
